note: Baseline of the CURRENT edited_number textual predicate. It catches every genuine alteration (recall 1.0) and 16 ordinary pairs with it (precision 0.333). A fix must raise precision while HOLDING recall at 1.0 — this rule accuses a document of tampering, so a false positive is louder than a missed one, but losing a real one is what the rule exists for. Regenerate with: npm run eval:gate -- forensic-edited --update
